title: Script-Capable Windows Utility Referencing Remote Content
detection_hypothesis: If a signed script-capable utility is used to pull remote content, the command line will contain a URL scheme rather than a local path.

field_semantics.Image: Absolute path of the executable backing the created process.
field_semantics.CommandLine: Full command line including arguments as supplied to the process.

collection_prerequisites: A process creation source is enabled (Sysmon Event ID 1 or Security Event ID 4688).
Command-line auditing is enabled when Security 4688 is the only available source.
expected_collection_gaps: Security 4688 without command-line auditing provides no CommandLine value.
Short-lived processes may be lost if the agent is restarted during collection.
normalization_assumptions: Image and ParentImage are absolute paths using backslash separators.
CommandLine retains the original argument order and spacing.
ingestion_differences: Some pipelines lowercase paths; the lab matcher is case-insensitive by default.
Sysmon and 4688 differ in parent process fidelity and in User field formatting.
retention_considerations: Process creation is high volume; 30 to 90 days of hot retention is typical.
expected_volume: Low; spikes during application deployment campaigns.
false_positive_strategy: Benign matches point at internal distribution hosts and repeat on a predictable schedule. Tune on the destination host portion of the command line combined with the parent deployment process.
tuning_guidance: Exclude the specific internal distribution hostname rather than the URL scheme. Removing the https prefix from the selection would defeat the rule.
test_strategy: Positive cases exercise two different utilities with remote references. Negative cases keep the same utilities on local paths and add a non-matching browser.
unmapped_defensive_objects_reason: No Detection Strategy, Analytic, or Data Component identifier for this technique was present in the pinned ATT&CK extraction used by this lab. Defensive arrays are left empty rather than populated with unverified identifiers. Unmapped techniques: T1218.010.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
